verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents a broad set of official SDKs a developer can build against on this GPU. These include the CUDA Toolkit (libraries, compiler, runtime, debugging tools), cuTile Python and CUDA Tile C++, the CUDA-X/RAPIDS libraries cuML and cuDF, the Video Codec SDK, the RTX Neural Shaders SDK, the Holoscan SDK installable via pip, and the NGC catalog of SDKs. A community critic notes that because the card is SM120, it lacks tmem/tcgen05 and gets weaker support in the main libraries, which focus on SM100/B300. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs on this card, and clarity on SM120-specific coverage gaps in the core libraries.
